clips.title: The story
paras: On the road east from Ashenvale, the Warsong Outrider watches the Horde's frontier. She scouts for the Warsong clan, watches travelers, and sends intelligence to its forward encampments. She keeps watch unless someone provokes her.

The Warsong Outrider watches the road between Ashenvale and Azshara's shattered ruins. Far from Splintertree Post and the lumber camps, she tracks troop movements along the route. Her bow and toxic stingers are ready, but she fires only at Alliance trespassers who attack her.
